_comment: Sidecar allowlist for update_label_db / lint_pret_labels (fidelity plan Stage 2.1).
relocated_files / relocated_labels are a LEGACY-DEBT inventory, not permission or precedent. NEW RELOCATIONS ARE FORBIDDEN.
Every pret counterpart belongs at dos_port/src/<pret path>; move legacy entries back to their mirrors when touched.
structural_findings records audited legacy violations as OPEN debt, never precedent or authority for new work.
Agents may not add entries or edit either category to make their own lint failure pass; registry edits may only retire/reclassify debt and the exact file hash is approved outside the worktree.
Legacy entries began as a 2026-07-07 full-tree inventory and remain subject to structural audit.

bank_splits: the relocated_files entries are ONE sanctioned class, not per-file decisions — pret's 27 `scripts/<Map>_N.asm` bank continuations, which the port merges into dos_port/src/scripts/<Map>.asm because it has no banks. Maintainer-directed 2026-08-20 ("Banks should all be allow list ignored"). They are the only structural difference left between the port's script layer and pret's, are excluded from the legacy-relocation debt counter, and are NOT precedent for anything else.
